topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Ah, t'is a strange thing, this wealth hidden like a buried seed. Johannes, he lives next to us, always been so kind, lending a hand in the hay or a word when the rain beat too hard on the fields. Turns out, he's got a chest full of coins, more than we can count. Could’ve lorded it over all of us, could’ve bought fine clothes and fancy beans, but he didn’t. He kept to his honest ways, sharing his pastures with our cattle, helping Harriet when her roof needed thatch. Maybe he’s got his reasons for the hiding, but what matters is how he’s always been a brother to us. We’re better for having him here, rich or poor.
